content.study:
Section 43J — Norms for accreditation of arbitrators

Section 43J provides that qualifications, experience and norms for accreditation of arbitrators are to be specified by regulations under the current statutory text.

The provision belongs to the Arbitration Council of India framework. Its operative use depends on the current text, commencement status and regulations made under the Act.
